definitionZh: 对象-视图框 CSS 属性将矩形定义为被替换元素内的可查看区域(viewbox),使得被替换元素的内容能够被放大或平板化. 它的工作原理类似于SVG属性.
sourceDefinition: The object-view-box CSS property defines a rectangle as a viewable area (viewbox) within a replaced elements, enabling the content of the replaced element to be zoomed or panned. It works similarly to the SVG attribute.
